title: gratiola ramosa subsp. drummondii
intro: Gratiola ramosa subsp. drummondii, commonly known as Drummond's gratiola, is a plant species in the family Plantaginaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Gratiola ramosa subsp. drummondii include alkaloids, such as harman and norharman, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory effects. The plant is also said to have antiseptic and antispasmodic properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions.
